stem.en: Laplace's equation u_xx + u_yy = 0 has A = 1, B = 0, C = 1. What type is it, and what does that predict about the kind of boundary conditions it needs?
stem.et: Laplace' võrrandil u_xx + u_yy = 0 on A = 1, B = 0, C = 1. Milline on selle tüüp, ja mida see ennustab vajaminevate rajatingimuste kohta?

label.en: Elliptic (B² − 4AC = −4 < 0) — it needs boundary conditions specified all around the region's boundary, not initial conditions on an open edge
label.et: Elliptiline (B² − 4AC = −4 < 0) — see vajab rajatingimusi määratud kogu piirkonna raja ulatuses, mitte algtingimusi lahtisel rajal

label.en: Hyperbolic, since B² − 4AC = 0 + 4 = 4 > 0 by adding instead of subtracting 4AC
label.et: Hüperboolne, kuna B² − 4AC = 0 + 4 = 4 > 0, kui 4AC liidetakse, mitte lahutatakse

label.en: It depends on which specific harmonic function u(x,y) you pick as the solution
label.et: See sõltub sellest, millise konkreetse harmoonilise funktsiooni u(x,y) lahendiks valid

label.en: Elliptic, but it can equally well be given initial data on an open edge like the wave equation, since the boundary-condition requirement doesn't actually depend on the type
label.et: Elliptiline, kuid sellele võib täpselt samamoodi anda algandmed lahtisel rajal nagu lainevõrrandile, kuna rajatingimuse nõue ei sõltu tegelikult tüübist
